# IMDB-Movie-Sales-Dashboard
# 🎬 IMDB Movie Sales Analysis Dashboard

## 📌 Project Overview

The **IMDB Movie Sales Analysis Dashboard** is an interactive Power BI dashboard created to analyze movie performance using the IMDB Movie Dataset. The dashboard provides insights into movie ratings, revenue trends, genres, directors, runtime analysis, and yearly movie releases.

This project helps users explore:

* Movie performance trends over the years
* Revenue generated by movies and directors
* IMDB ratings by genre
* Movie counts by genre and year
* Runtime and revenue analysis

The dashboard is designed using Power BI with a dark-themed cinematic layout for better visualization and storytelling.

---

# 📂 Dataset Information

## Dataset Name

`IMDB-Movie-Data.csv`

## Total Records

* **1000 Movies**

## Total Columns

* **12 Columns**

## Dataset Columns

| Column Name        | Description                   |
| ------------------ | ----------------------------- |
| Rank               | Ranking of the movie          |
| Title              | Name of the movie             |
| Genre              | Movie genre/category          |
| Description        | Short movie description       |
| Director           | Director name                 |
| Actors             | Main actors in the movie      |
| Year               | Release year                  |
| Runtime (Minutes)  | Movie duration in minutes     |
| Rating             | IMDB rating                   |
| Votes              | Number of votes received      |
| Revenue (Millions) | Revenue generated in millions |
| Metascore          | Critic review score           |

---

# 📊 Dashboard Features

## KPI Cards

The dashboard includes important KPI cards such as:

* 🎥 **Total Count of Movies**
* ⭐ **Maximum IMDB Rating**
* ⏱️ **Average Runtime (Minutes)**
* 💰 **Average Revenue (Millions)**

---

# 📈 Visualizations Used

## 1. Movies Released by Year

* Displays the number of movies released each year.
* Helps identify trends in movie production.

## 2. Total Revenue (Millions) by Year

* Shows yearly revenue trends.
* Useful for understanding growth in movie revenue over time.

## 3. Highest Revenue by Director

* Displays directors with the highest total revenue.
* Helps compare director performance.

## 4. Maximum IMDB Rating by Genre

* Shows the highest ratings across genres.
* Useful for identifying top-performing genres.

## 5. Total Revenue by Genre

* Analyzes revenue generated by each genre.
* Helps identify profitable movie categories.

## 6. Count of Movies by Genre

* Displays movie distribution across genres.
* Helps understand genre popularity.

---

# 🎛️ Filters and Slicers

The dashboard contains interactive slicers for:

* Director
* Year
* Genre

These filters allow users to dynamically analyze data based on selected criteria.

# 🛠️ Tools & Technologies Used

| Tool                  | Purpose                              |
| --------------------- | ------------------------------------ |
| Power BI              | Dashboard creation and visualization |
| Microsoft Excel / CSV | Data source                          |
| DAX                   | Calculations and measures            |
| Power Query           | Data cleaning and transformation     |

---

# 📌 DAX Measures Used

## Total Movies

```DAX
Total Movies = COUNT('IMDB-Movie-Data'[Title])
```

## Maximum Rating

```DAX
Max Rating = MAX('IMDB-Movie-Data'[Rating])
```

## Average Runtime

```DAX
Avg Runtime = AVERAGE('IMDB-Movie-Data'[Runtime (Minutes)])
```

## Average Revenue

```DAX
Avg Revenue = AVERAGE('IMDB-Movie-Data'[Revenue (Millions)])
```

## Total Revenue

```DAX
Total Revenue = SUM('IMDB-Movie-Data'[Revenue (Millions)])
```

# 📌 Key Insights

* The dataset contains movies from multiple genres and years.
* Certain directors generated significantly higher revenue.
* Revenue trends increased over time.
* Action and Adventure genres contributed major revenue.
* High-rated movies are distributed across multiple genres.
